# alberyt.xyz

> Albert Gabor builds AI automation and software for businesses that run on paperwork and manual processes: document pipelines, workflow automation and self-hosted systems, on infrastructure the client controls. Based in Timișoara, Romania; works in Romanian and English.

The site describes his services, selected work, how he works, what he is building now, and how to book a call. It is self-hosted on his own hardware and available in English and Romanian.

## Services
- Document pipelines: documents (PDFs, scans, emails) turned into structured, validated data for the client's systems, with people reviewing only the exceptions. Starts with one document type and one destination.
- Workflow automation: recurring requests, approvals and reports run on their own, with every run logged and a person in the loop where it matters. Starts with one recurring process.
- Private AI search and internal tools: search, assistants and internal tools over internal files, running on the client's servers or in the EU. Starts with one knowledge base or one internal tool.
- Any engagement can start with a fixed-scope, 2-week pilot on one process.

## How he works
- Privacy by default: systems only see the data they need, and nothing leaves without the client's agreement.
- Data stays on the client's infrastructure or with EU-hosted providers.
- Every automated step is logged and auditable.
- Deliverables, timeline and price are agreed in writing before work starts.
- Has run his own production infrastructure since 2024: about 130 containers, monitored and backed up weekly.

## Selected work
- [EHDS-Service](https://github.com/Albert-4096/EHDS-Service): a nine-stage pipeline that converts Romanian hospital discharge PDFs into valid HL7 FHIR R4 bundles (Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript). Built at HackTM 2026, where Albert led the build with his team and it won the Product Innovation track (€2,000, sponsored by Aumovio). Public demo with a synthetic patient: https://ehds.alberyt.xyz
- Private knowledge search (own system, 2026): ingests, transcribes, embeds and indexes 5,500+ items, with hybrid search that AI assistants can query directly.
- Event check-in desk for TEDxAristide Demetriade (September 2026), an event he helps run: a web-based check-in desk on top of the guest list, which ran guest check-in at the door on the day.

## Lab
- [Cryptography Atlas](https://crypto.alberyt.xyz): visual guides to AES, RSA and SHA-256.
- [LCG Visualizer](https://lcg.alberyt.xyz): a linear congruential generator's output as a grayscale image, checked against the Hull–Dobell theorem.
- [mail-platform](https://github.com/Albert-4096/mail-platform): webmail for his own domains on Resend, with required TOTP.
- [Auth System](https://github.com/Albert-4096/auth-system): a small dockerized authentication backend (Argon2, JWT, PostgreSQL).
- Open-source fixes merged upstream: [NandhaKishorM/laya#264](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/264) and [Freika/dawarich#3595](https://github.com/Freika/dawarich/pull/3595).
- [Nonlinear Thinking](https://nonlinear-thinking.alberyt.xyz) and [Opere BAC](https://github.com/Albert-4096/opere-bac-website), a study site for the Romanian Baccalaureate literature exam.
